szoveg_eredeti:
As generative AI and agentic systems move from experimentation to core business operations, the legal implications are no longer theoretical. Regulatory frameworks are taking shape across jurisdictions—from the EU AI Act to evolving approaches in the UK, Canada, Australia and the US—and the pace of change is accelerating.

Whether deploying AI tools internally, integrating third-party AI into products and services or navigating sector-specific oversight, businesses need practical, strategic legal guidance. From intellectual property (IP) and data privacy to liability, governance and procurement, we help clients manage AI-related risk and seize opportunity with confidence.

Explore the latest insights from lawyers across Norton Rose Fulbright's global network on the AI developments, risks and opportunities shaping business today.
